I LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE THEM!!!! Despite what the previous comments say these are not even heavy at all! Very light weight and can’t even tell they’re on! But I would and will be buying another set of these! They’re real cute for an everyday wear.
Adorable and well made!!! Only complaint is they are not as big as the one in the seller product image but its ok! I love them!!

reviews.t: Not as big in picture but still amazing
reviews.x: The only thing I was bummed about is that they weren't as big as the picture displays. But other than that they're still a good size and are my favorite earrings I own now. I've seen other reviews say that they were too heavy for them to wear for longer than a couple hours but I wear them daily all day long every single day and have had no problems, they're very lightweight. Honestly this was a very good purchase and for how cheap they were I was surprised at how good the quality is, definitely

i bought these to go with my halloween costume for this year, and i’m very disappointed not with the quality, but with the size. i usually wear very large hoop earrings, and these were silver dollar sized. they came with no earring backs either. they’re very good quality, but if you’re looking for oversized hoops, these are not what you should get.

reviews.t: Super cute and not cheaply made.
reviews.x: I'm very impressed on the size, I thought they'd come out too small or too big but they're perfect! Yeah they're a little heavy but I've wore things that were worse. Definitely not cheap material! Even matches with the necklace I bought on here a week ago! ^.^

I got this product very fast and it’s the perfect earring for me to show off my witchy side they are great quality my ears don’t irritate or turn green ! The only downside is that I can only wear them for about an hour before they get too heavy.

I love these!  Happily better than described!  Quality,  exactly what I was looking for.
Exactly what I wanted! Received many compliments on them. They’re so much fun to wear.

reviews.t: Almost worth paying twice for, stunning craftsmanship for the price
reviews.x: The package came empty. That has never happened with Amazon. So I let them know it needed to be replaced it was an empty envelope. They wanted a refund to go down but I just wanted the earings. They did eventually "exhange" them (the empty envelope for the new BEAUTIFUL) earings I received) then I was told to return the old "damaged" earings or I'd get charged. It was a mess. Impressed with the quality for the price. Had these for a few months and they’ve held up nice. They have a nice weight to them so they’re not too heavy on the ears. Sometimes my ears are sensitive to the material/weight but they haven’t bothered me at all:) would recommend

I love these earrings. They definitely make a statement! They’re well constructed, and aren’t fragile like many other cheap pieces of jewelry. Be aware they are a just a little heavy if you’re not used to wearing earrings, or have sensitive ear lobes.

a lot smaller then i thought but i should’ve expected that from the price but over all good. i always put a protective coating on jewelry like that so it doesn’t rust or anything so i’m not sure about that

claims.text: Many reviewers find the earrings cute, well made, and good quality for the price.
Several reviewers note the earrings are smaller than shown in the product image.
Some reviewers mention the earrings feel heavy or can only be worn for a limited time.
A few reviewers describe the earrings as lightweight and comfortable for everyday wear.
